contract.purpose: Copy a rejected shipment detail to another shipment, mark the original rejected and copy comments.
inputs_defaults: CREATE PROCEDURE TransferRejectedDetail @internalLineNum numeric(9), @newStatus numeric(3), @rejStatus numeric(3), @qtyAtSts1 numeric(19,5), @toShipNum numeric(9), @toShipId nvarchar(25) AS
Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Missing source yields no identity and explicit throw; negative/NULL quantities and statuses are not rejected locally. Source identity uniqueness and target constraints affect validity.
output_shape: No explicit result set or returned new line number. Missing new identity raises THROW50000; caught exceptions are rethrown.

ordered_branches.explanation: Begins transaction with XACT_ABORT ON. Copies explicit source detail columns to target shipment number/ID; sets status1/new quantity bucket1 from arguments, zeros status2..10 and quantities2..10 plus launch, clears immediate-needs note and refreshes UTC time. Other totals, including TOTAL_QTY/volume/weight/value and REQUESTED_QTY, are copied rather than recalculated from supplied bucket quantity. Captures SCOPE_IDENTITY and throws if NULL. Calls target STH_UpdateHeader before marking original status1 rejected and zeroing original TOTAL_QTY/volume/weight/value; original quantity/status buckets2..10 and quantity bucket1 are not cleared here. Refreshes original shipment header, then copies all comments for source line/fixed record type to new line/target shipment. Child return codes are not captured, so nonzero returns without thrown errors do not trigger catch. No target shipment existence/company/warehouse or amount validation.
